description: Compare two or more package options by price and quantity to find the true cost per unit (price / quantity) for each, flag the cheapest, and report how much more expensive each other option is by percentage. Unit-agnostic: pass quantity in whatever unit makes the options comparable (grams, litres, item count, etc.), no conversion is done.

items.description: Two or more package options to compare

price.description: Total price of this option (must be greater than zero)

quantity.description: Quantity in whatever unit makes options comparable (must be greater than zero)

name: compare_unit_prices
